evidence.title: morphicons — SVG icon morphing library for React, Vue & Svelte
GitHub - guillermolg00/morphicons: Any icon morphs into any other — universal morphing for stroke-based icons with spring physics.

name: morphicons
summary: Icon-morphing library: any stroke SVG icon morphs into any other with spring physics — React, Vue, Svelte, vanilla.
description: npm library that animates one stroke-based icon into another (Lucide, Tabler, Heroicons outline, Iconoir or custom paths); rotation is solved in closed form via 2D Procrustes alignment, springs are interruptible and the core is a ~6.5 KB gzip zero-dependency ESM/TypeScript package. Ships bindings for React, Vue, Svelte, React Native and Astro plus adapters for Iconify markup, CSS masks and canvas targets.
contains: any stroke icon morphs into any other — no per-pair configuration
closed-form 2D Procrustes rotation, interruptible springs, sharp corners at rest
~6.5 KB gzip core, zero runtime dependencies, ESM + TypeScript
bindings: React, Vue, Svelte, React Native, Astro, web component, vanilla DOM
adapters: SVG markup in, CSS mask targets, canvas/WebGL targets
controlled mode (from/to/progress), imperative handle and reduced-motion policy
